# Naming conventions
Load when: you name a project, cycle, milestone, label or activity
Applies to: lpm-plan-work, lpm-workspace-admin    Source: legacy `software-project-orchestrator` naming conventions; cards `create_project`, `create_cycle`, `create_milestone`, `create_label`, `create_issue`
Owner skill: lpm-plan-work

## Summary
- Projects: "<Domain or Product> <Initiative>", key of 3–6 uppercase letters, no "Project"/"Team" prefixes.
- Cycles: "YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD". Milestones: name the outcome, not the activity.
- Labels are universal (shared by every workspace): reuse before creating; no synonyms.
- Activities: "<Verb> <object> <qualifier>", starting with a verb.
- Check existing names first: create tools do not deduplicate.

## Facts
| Object | Convention | Consequence for the agent |
|---|---|---|
| project name | `<Domain or Product> <Initiative>` (e.g. "Checkout Parcelamento") | avoid redundant words like Project, Team, Initiative |
| project key | 3–6 uppercase letters (e.g. `MOB`, `PLAT`) | `list_projects` first: `create_project` is not idempotent |
| cycle name | `<YYYY-MM-DD> to <YYYY-MM-DD>`, alternative `Sprint <number> <YYYY>` | never "Current Sprint"; `create_cycle` also needs `startDate` and `endDate` |
| milestone name | the outcome reached (e.g. "Pix em produção") | never duplicate a cycle name; `create_milestone` needs `targetDate` |
| label name | small reusable taxonomy; one name per meaning | `create_label` needs `color` `#rrggbb`; labels affect every workspace |
| activity title | `<Verb> <object> <qualifier>` (e.g. "Corrigir redirect do login no Safari") | never just a component name; ≤500 characters on OAuth |
| activity description | what will be done + acceptance criteria | the closure check reads the criteria |

## Rules
1. List the existing objects before creating one; equal after lowercase and trim → reuse it.
2. Write names in the workspace's language; keep keys in uppercase ASCII.
3. Do not rename shared labels without a [C] confirmation that says every workspace is affected.

## Examples
```text
example: project "Mobile App Rewrite" key MOBR; cycle "2026-10-06 to 2026-10-17";
milestone "Login social em produção"; activity "Implementar login com Apple no iOS"
```
